name: spring-cleaning-omen-to-graveyard-looks-three-banishes-deep-card-as-omen-rest-bottom
notes: Spring Cleaning (dZ0Y2ILgZW): an omen goes to the graveyard, the top three cards are looked at, the third (Fairy Whispers) is banished as a new omen and the other two go to the bottom in order; a marker sits below them. Pre-fix only the top card was looked at.

rulesClauses: Put one of your omens into your graveyard. If you do, look at the top three cards of your deck. Banish one of them and put an omen counter on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated customDQHandlers["dZ0Y2ILgZW:0:CardActivated-1"] looked at the top three cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever looked at (the player's 'choice' was a single card and nothing else went to the bottom of the deck). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the handler is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone().
